LanguageData.SD_Help: Draft normally to stay drafted. Manual and forced undrafting still work. The optional per-pawn button is hidden by default.
LanguageData.SD_ShowButton: Show the optional Allow auto-undraft button (default: off)
LanguageData.SD_AllowAutoDesc: Allow vanilla idle automatic undrafting for this pawn. Off by default: an ordinary Draft command stays active. This button does not draft or undraft the pawn immediately.
